My name no matter, but I go tell you how I dey plan this my maize plot. The land no big, only small piece near the house, so my wife and children go help me. I go buy small urea from the market after the rain start good, because without fertilizer the maize no dey yield well for our soil here. I get small manure from the goats and chickens wey I go carry put before planting, and I go buy improved maize seed from the agro-dealer because that armyworm problem don spoil plenty farm these last years — I go need small sprayer too. I no get pump or river close, so na rain I dey rely on.
